VIDEO_EXTS

Video extensions the pipeline normalizes into h264 mp4 + scaledown + posters.

MEDIA_EXTS

Union of every accepted extension — the drop-time filter.

isMediaPath

Reports whether a file name/path carries a supported media extension. Extension check is case-insensitive; names with no dot, dotfiles (.DS_Store) and unknown extensions all report false so OS litter inside dropped folders never reaches the queue.

  • @param name — file name or relative path
  • @returns true when the extension is a known image or video format
